annotations.title: Market depth and cost to trade

description: What it costs to trade an instrument now, per venue (Hyperliquid, GMX on Arbitrum and Avalanche): resting depth within 1% and 2% of the mid and the cost to fill $10k, $100k, $1M and $10M in basis points (derived each hour from the venue’s book; the book is never stored), open interest, hourly funding and volume; GMX’s pools’ remaining room. Says "not yet read" before the hourly job has run. FREE at $10k and $100k; $1M, $10M and any size are paid.
